overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the pre-meeting exchanges between Board members about the revised notice, a pulled anonymous letter, and how to read complaints into the record were administrative, not deliberation, though it was a close call.

allegations.summary: Alleged that before the posted Nov. 14 meeting, Board members discussed OML complaints on the revised notice and a pulled letter, which was deliberation outside a posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: While it is a close call, we find that the communications did not constitute deliberation.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
